name: ema-flow
description: Deterministic HL7 Global ePI Type 2 to EMA EU ePI interoperability pipeline on Google Cloud

scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run artifacts:check && npm run images:check && npm run contracts:check && npm run test:coverage
scripts.contracts:check: node scripts/ci/check-generated.mjs --run "npm run contracts:generate && npm run vectors:generate && npm run contracts:fixtures && npm run contracts:quote-edge && npm run differential:smoke && npm run authority:vectors" -- contracts/generated test/fixtures/fidelity/vectors.json test/fixtures/contracts zone-a/tests/fixtures/differential-smoke.jsonl test/fixtures/authority/vectors.json
scripts.renderer:smoke: docker run --rm --network none --read-only --tmpfs /tmp --shm-size=1g --cap-drop=ALL --security-opt=no-new-privileges --pids-limit=2048 --memory=6g --env RENDERER_NO_SANDBOX=1 --volume "$PWD:/work:ro" renderer:local node --import tsx scripts/render/smoke.ts
scripts.renderer:check: docker run --rm --network none --read-only --tmpfs /tmp --shm-size=1g --cap-drop=ALL --security-opt=no-new-privileges --pids-limit=2048 --memory=6g --env RENDERER_NO_SANDBOX=1 --volume "$PWD:/work:ro" renderer:local node --import tsx scripts/render/check.ts
scripts.renderer:fonts: docker run --rm --network none --read-only --tmpfs /tmp --shm-size=1g --cap-drop=ALL --security-opt=no-new-privileges --pids-limit=2048 --memory=6g --env RENDERER_NO_SANDBOX=1 --volume "$PWD:/work:ro" renderer:local node --import tsx scripts/render/check-fonts.ts
scripts.renderer:drawings: docker run --rm --network none --read-only --tmpfs /tmp --shm-size=1g --cap-drop=ALL --security-opt=no-new-privileges --pids-limit=2048 --memory=6g --env RENDERER_NO_SANDBOX=1 --volume "$PWD:/work:ro" renderer:local node --import tsx scripts/render/check-drawings.ts
scripts.renderer:boxes: docker run --rm --network none --read-only --tmpfs /tmp --shm-size=1g --cap-drop=ALL --security-opt=no-new-privileges --pids-limit=2048 --memory=6g --env RENDERER_NO_SANDBOX=1 --volume "$PWD:/work:ro" renderer:local node --import tsx scripts/render/check-boxes.ts
